description: Look up a Steam profile and its archived history: earlier names, custom URLs and avatars, and other accounts that held the same custom URL. Costs 1 credit (or one of a pack's free daily tool searches); finding nothing or failing costs nothing.

max_wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning what has arrived so far (default 50). The tool keeps running on OSINT.SX after that, so its credit may still be used.

query.description: A custom URL, SteamID64 (the 17-digit account number) or profile URL.

name: steam_history
title: Steam profile history
